allowed_internal_inputs: docs/audits/oblivion-oss-comprehensive-audit-2026-08-24/03-feature-to-benchmark-matrix.csv rows for the three assigned feature IDs
input_boundary.prohibited_internal_inputs_attestation: No Oblivion application source and no RUN-040, RUN-041, RUN-043, RUN-044, RUN-045, RUN-046, or current-product evidence was inspected.
input_boundary.external_source_policy: Official upstream repositories and official project documentation only; repository evidence was pinned to immutable commit SHAs.

HR_REHIRE_INVITE.limit: Targeted repository tree, employee lifecycle loci, and official documentation review; not a universe-wide absence proof.

MED_BOUNDED_01.limit: OpenEMR target loci were inspected in detail; the other official repositories received bounded tree/path triage. This is not a repository-wide absence proof or final no-match.

FIN_BOUNDED_01.limit: Detailed inspection of the official BankingMatching module and its schema; no final benchmark selection.

official_ref.edition_boundary: ERPNext public repository only; hosted Frappe Cloud and uninspected Frappe Framework behavior excluded.

observed_behaviors: The Employee document assigns its identifier through a naming series, validates lifecycle state, dates, email, reporting relationships, and preferred contact data before persistence.
HR User and HR Manager metadata grant create, read, and write authority.
After insert, optional automatic linked-user creation is invoked when a usable employee email exists.
gaps: Framework-level persistence, transaction, and record-level permission execution are outside the pinned ERPNext repository slice.
Approved-Site scope, sensitive-field privacy, concurrency, and idempotency are not established.
facets.eligibility: ELIGIBLE_FOR_LATER_CLEAN_COMPARISON_AS_A_CREATE_BEHAVIOR_CANDIDATE; framework assumptions and privacy controls must remain unknown.

official_ref.edition_boundary: ERPNext public repository only; Frappe Framework enforcement and hosted editions excluded.

observed_behaviors: The Employee list defaults to Active records and renders status indicators for Active, Inactive, Left, and Suspended.
The Employee document exposes Overview, Profile, and Connections areas.
Employee, HR User, and HR Manager roles have read metadata; create and write remain limited to the HR roles in this locus.
gaps: The pinned source does not establish field-level privacy or the complete row-level user-permission evaluation performed by Frappe Framework.
Approved-Site scope and direct-object concealment are not established.
facets.eligibility: ELIGIBLE_FOR_LATER_CLEAN_COMPARISON_AS_A_PROFILE_VIEW_CANDIDATE; authorization claims must stop at the evidenced role metadata.

official_ref.edition_boundary: ERPNext public repository only; external framework internals excluded.

observed_behaviors: HR User and HR Manager metadata grant write authority.
Updates revalidate lifecycle, dates, email, reporting relationships, linked-user uniqueness, and preferred contact details.
A linked user's Employee role, selected personal fields, image, and optional Employee and Company user permissions are synchronized.
gaps: Optimistic concurrency, stale-write handling, idempotency, and a complete durable audit event are not established.
Sensitive-field and approved-Site authorization are not established.

observed_behaviors: Employee status is constrained to Active, Inactive, Suspended, or Left.
Moving to Left requires a relieving date and is blocked while active employees still report to the departing employee.
A non-Active status disables the linked user, while return to Active re-enables it.
gaps: The source does not establish a separate approval, effective-dated transition record, or durable lifecycle audit event.
Reactivation must not be treated as evidenced rehire.
Concurrent status changes and retry semantics are not established.

official_ref.edition_boundary: OrangeHRM Starter public repository only; current help-center Workforce Management behavior is not assumed edition-equivalent.

observed_behaviors: ERPNext re-enables a linked user when an Employee record returns to Active.
OrangeHRM Starter clears the current termination pointer through deletion while its Employee entity also models a collection of termination records.
OrangeHRM's official help article describes Reactivate Employment and optionally updating the joined date, but the page does not establish equivalence to the pinned Starter repository.
gaps: No inspected edition-matched locus establishes a distinct rehire transaction, new service period, rehire effective date, rehire reason, authority, or downstream contract and entitlement consequences.
Simple reactivation is insufficient evidence for rehire semantics.
facets.eligibility: NOT_ELIGIBLE_AS_AN_EXACT_REHIRE_CANDIDATE; later comparison requires edition-matched source proving service-period and provenance behavior.

official_ref.edition_boundary: ERPNext public repository only; Frappe Framework mail and token behavior excluded.

observed_behaviors: An authorized Employee write path can create an enabled User from an employee email, assign the Employee role, link it to the Employee, and optionally add Employee and Company user permissions.
The official documentation labels this behavior Create User for new or existing employees.
gaps: The pinned target-specific source does not establish invitation issuance, one-time token, delivery state, expiry, acceptance, resend, cancellation, or recovery.
Any welcome-email or password-setup behavior implemented by external Frappe Framework was not inspected and cannot be inferred.
facets.eligibility: NOT_ELIGIBLE_AS_AN_EXACT_INVITATION_CANDIDATE; eligible only as adjacent linked-user-creation evidence.

observed_behaviors: Employee work information carries a HorillaAuditLog and exposes tracked diffs.
A profile History tab and employee-list history sidebar render the same activity-history feed.
The feed presents an explicit empty state when no changes exist.
gaps: The evidenced feed is driven by EmployeeWorkInformation tracking; complete personal-profile, activation, invitation, termination, and rehire coverage is not established.
Tamper resistance, retention, export, and approved-Site filtering are not established.
facets.eligibility: ELIGIBLE_FOR_LATER_CLEAN_COMPARISON_AS_A USER-VISIBLE WORK-INFORMATION HISTORY CANDIDATE; not evidence of a complete canonical lifecycle ledger.

official_ref.edition_boundary: OpenEMR public repository only; bounded target and adjacent inventory loci.

observed_behaviors: OpenEMR provides an ACL-protected drug-inventory view with facility or warehouse restriction, lot, expiry, and on-hand quantity.
A separate prescription locus records a controlled-substance reporting flag.
gaps: No inspected query or model joins the controlled-substance flag to the inventory view as a controlled-drug register.
Register entries, running-balance chronology, resident or prescription provenance, and controlled-drug-specific visibility are not established.
facets.eligibility: NOT_ELIGIBLE_AS_AN_EXACT CONTROLLED-DRUG REGISTER VIEW CANDIDATE; generic inventory remains adjacent evidence only under MED_BOUNDED_01.

observed_behaviors: Generic inventory exposes purchases, transfers, adjustments, consumption, destruction, returns, edits, and dispensing.
Dispensing records a drug sale only when inventory is available.
Controlled-substance reporting remains a separate prescription flag.
gaps: No append-only controlled-drug movement entry binds movement type, before and after balance, actor, recipient, reason, witness, and controlled-drug identity.
Atomicity, locking, correction semantics, and Site-specific register ownership are not established.
facets.eligibility: NOT_ELIGIBLE_AS_AN_EXACT CONTROLLED-DRUG MOVEMENT CANDIDATE; bounded generic inventory evidence only.

observed_behaviors: The generic inventory query exposes and can sort by each lot's on-hand quantity.
Destroyed lots are excluded from the active inventory query.
gaps: A displayed on-hand value is not an evidenced balance-check workflow.
No physical count, expected-versus-observed comparison, checker identity, witness, effective time, lock, pass or fail state, or signed reconciliation is established.
The inventory is not evidenced as controlled-drug-specific.

observed_behaviors: The generic inventory grants a distinct adjustments permission and exposes adjustment, consumption, return, or edit actions for lots.
gaps: No inspected locus detects or opens a discrepancy case, freezes unsafe activity, requires recount, preserves the original balance, records investigation and resolution, or routes escalation.
No controlled-drug-specific authority or witness rule is established.
A generic stock adjustment must not be treated as discrepancy resolution.

observed_behaviors: An administrator can mark an inventory lot with destruction date, method, free-text witness, and notes after CSRF validation.
A date-ranged report projects destroyed lots with on-hand quantity, method, witness, and notes.
gaps: The destruction path and report are generic drug-inventory behaviors and are not joined to the separate controlled-substance prescription flag.
The source marks a lot destroyed; it does not establish a controlled-drug movement ledger, partial-destruction accounting, pre and post balance, or immutable correction.
Witness identity and authority are not validated.
facets.eligibility: NOT_ELIGIBLE_AS_AN_EXACT CONTROLLED-DRUG DESTRUCTION PROJECTION; eligible only as adjacent generic destruction-report behavior.

observed_behaviors: Destroy-lot access requires the admin/drugs permission.
The destruction form accepts witness as free text and the destroyed-drugs report displays that value.
gaps: Free text is not authenticated witness identity or authority.
No distinct witness permission, medication competency, independence rule, second-person confirmation, signature, refusal, or unavailable-witness path is established.
The acting administrator and alleged witness are not evidenced as separate accountable actors.
facets.eligibility: NOT_ELIGIBLE_AS_AN EXACT WITNESS-AUTHORITY CANDIDATE UNDER MED_BOUNDED_01.

official_ref.edition_boundary: Public BigCapital repository only; cloud operation excluded.

observed_behaviors: Current match rows retain source transaction ID, reference type, reference ID, amount, and timestamps.
Unmatching deletes the current matched-bank-transaction rows inside a unit of work.
gaps: Hard deletion on unmatch prevents these rows from establishing durable allocation-history review.
Actor, reason, previous state, settlement identity, review decision, and immutable provenance are not stored in the inspected schema.
Bank matching must not be assumed equivalent to payment-allocation history.
facets.eligibility: NOT_ELIGIBLE_AS_AN EXACT ALLOCATION-HISTORY CANDIDATE; BigCapital remains only a bounded potential finance candidate.

official_ref.edition_boundary: Public BigCapital repository only; cloud operation excluded.

observed_behaviors: The matched-transactions endpoint returns perfect and possible candidates for selected uncategorized bank transactions.
Candidate types include sale invoices, bills, expenses, manual journals, and cashflow records.
Candidates are sorted by closeness; same amount and same calendar day are classified as perfect matches, with remaining candidates classified as possible matches.
gaps: The inspected controller does not establish user-facing role authorization or privacy scope.
Suggestion explanation is limited to evidenced amount and date classification; confidence, rule provenance, and reviewer audit are not established.
This is bank-transaction matching, not yet evidence of payment-allocation equivalence.
facets.eligibility: ELIGIBLE_FOR_LATER CLEAN COMPARISON AS A SUGGESTED-MATCH REVIEW CANDIDATE ONLY; BigCapital is not selected as a winner.

official_ref.edition_boundary: Public BigCapital repository only; cloud operation excluded.

observed_behaviors: Confirmation accepts one or more uncategorized transaction IDs and reference entries.
Source rows are loaded in deterministic ID order and locked FOR UPDATE inside a unit of work.
The command rejects missing, excluded, or already-matched sources, invalid reference types or IDs, and totals differing by more than 0.01.
Validated match records are created and matching and matched events are emitted inside the transaction callback.
gaps: Stable request-key idempotency and same-request replay are not established.
User authorization, actor attribution, durable decision audit, and payment-settlement equivalence are not established.
Rollback details beyond the unit-of-work boundary are not evidenced in this inspected slice.
facets.eligibility: ELIGIBLE_FOR LATER CLEAN COMPARISON AS A MATCH-CONFIRMATION CANDIDATE ONLY; BigCapital remains unselected.

official_ref.edition_boundary: Public BigCapital repository only; cloud operation excluded.

observed_behaviors: The service can unmatch an already-confirmed source by deleting its current match rows and emitting unmatching and unmatched events.
Suggested perfect and possible candidates are returned, but no explicit rejection command appears in the inspected matching module.
gaps: Unmatch-after-confirmation is not the same as rejecting a proposed match.
No rejected state, candidate identity, reason, reviewer, timestamped rejection record, suppression rule, or reconsideration path is established.

official_ref.edition_boundary: Public BigCapital repository only; cloud operation excluded.

observed_behaviors: Source rows are locked during match confirmation and an already-matched source is rejected.
Current match rows carry reference identity and timestamps.
Match and unmatch events are emitted around creation or deletion.
gaps: Rejecting a repeat against an already-matched row is not stable-key replay.
No idempotency key, original-result replay, payload conflict response, settlement or journal identity, actor, decision reason, or immutable provenance chain is established.
Unmatch deletes current rows, so the inspected persistence does not preserve replay history.
facets.eligibility: NOT_ELIGIBLE_AS AN EXACT SETTLEMENT-REPLAY-AND-PROVENANCE CANDIDATE; BigCapital provides adjacent locking and duplicate-rejection evidence only.

credit_boundary.statement: These are official-upstream behavior and bounded no-candidate packets only. They do not compare against Oblivion, select a final mapping, establish a final no-match, award benchmark credit, or authorize copying.
